name: stipendariet
description: StipendieAssistenten monorepo — grant assistant application for Swedish foundations

scripts.dev:infra: docker compose -f docker-compose.yml up -d postgres redis browserless
scripts.dev:stop-infra: docker compose -f docker-compose.yml stop postgres redis browserless
scripts.dev:all: pnpm run dev:infra && turbo run dev
scripts.lint:backend: cd backend && (venv/bin/ruff check . || python3 -m ruff check .)
scripts.test:all: turbo run test test:e2e && pnpm run test:backend
scripts.format:check:py: cd backend && (venv/bin/ruff format --check . || python3 -m ruff format --check .)
scripts.format:check: pnpm run format:check:ts && pnpm run format:check:py
scripts.format:fix:py: cd backend && (venv/bin/ruff format . || python3 -m ruff format .)
scripts.format: pnpm run format:fix:ts && pnpm run format:fix:py
